title: Neon Tree in Crystal Orb
description: A glowing spherical glass orb contains a central metallic lamp post with branching, colorful neon-like tendrils in yellow, green, blue, pink and purple. Inside the orb is a surreal landscape with rolling green hills, distant gravestones, and silhouetted bare trees under a twilight sky with a green and pink glowing sun. Butterflies and bats fly both inside and outside the orb, which rests on an ornate dark metal stand atop a stone base.
prompt: Surreal scene of a large transparent crystal sphere containing a glowing central lamp post with colorful branching neon tendrils in yellow green blue pink and purple stretching outward like a tree. Inside the orb is a dreamy landscape with green hills, gravestones, and silhouetted trees beneath a glowing green and pink sunset. Butterflies and bats fly around both inside and outside the sphere. The orb sits on an ornate metallic stand on a stone pedestal. Mystical twilight atmosphere.
